title: A minimal point of the support of a quasi-coherent module is associated
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent F on a locally Noetherian X and a point x of the support that is not a specialisation of another point of the support, x is associated to F; in particular generic points of irreducible components of X are associated points of X (source lines 219-228). The proof mirrors its weakly associated companion: F_x is nonzero so Ass(F_x) is nonempty, minimality makes the support of F_x the single point m_x, and associated primes lie in the support.
